plan.title: Reject Surrogate Bid Without Rebid Permission

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Navigate to the RFQ Responses tab where the surrogate bid and Reject control are shown.
Open the rejection dialog for Vendor A's bid.
Assert that the rejection dialog opened.

args.text: Are you sure you want to reject this bid by Vendor A

steps.note: Verify the dialog identifies the correct vendor and rejection action.

args.text: Supplier would not be allowed to bid again. This action cannot be undone.

steps.note: Verify the warning for blocking the supplier from rebidding.

args.text: You have blocked the supplier from bidding again.

steps.note: Assert the confirmation that the supplier was blocked.
Verify the rejected bid displays the entered reason in the Responses view.
Open the RFQ Rejected Bids view.
Assert that the rejected-bids view opened.

args.text: Rejection Remark: Price not valid — QA

steps.note: Verify the rejected-bids record contains the rejection remark.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier-portal session.
Open the event's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor A sees the rejection reason in the supplier portal.
Attempt a new vendor quote and require visible refusal evidence, covering the immediate rebid block.
